#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> rock1(3), rock2(3), sci1(3), sci2(3), paper1(3), paper2(3);
    cin >> rock1[0] >> sci1[0] >> paper1[0];
    cin >> rock2[0] >> sci2[0] >> paper2[0];

    auto factors = [](long long n) {
        set<long long> s;
        for (long long i = 1; i * i <= n; ++i) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                s.insert(i);
                s.insert(n / i);
            }
        }
        return vector<long long>(s.begin(), s.end());
    };

    auto inv_mod = [](long long n, long long mod) {
        long long res = 1, p = mod - 2;
        long long base = n % mod;
        while (p > 0) {
            if (p & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    };

    int mod = 998244353;

    auto maximum = [&]() {
        int ans = min(rock1[0], sci2[0]) + min(sci1[0], paper2[0]) + min(paper1[0], rock2[0]);
        return ans;
    };

    auto match = [](int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        else
            return -1;
    };

    auto give = [&](vector<vector<int>> &l1, vector<vector<int>> &l2) {
        int ans = 0;
        int curr1 = 0, curr2 = 0;
        while (!l1.empty() || !l2.empty()) {
            if (curr1 == 0 && !l1.empty()) {
                curr1 = l1.back()[0];
                int t = l1.back()[1];
                l1.pop_back();
                curr1 = curr1 + (t << 16); // encode type in high bits
            }
            if (curr2 == 0 && !l2.empty()) {
                curr2 = l2.back()[0];
                int t = l2.back()[1];
                l2.pop_back();
                curr2 = curr2 + (t << 16);
            }
            if (curr1 == 0 || curr2 == 0) break;
            int c1 = curr1 & 0xFFFF;
            int t1 = curr1 >> 16;
            int c2 = curr2 & 0xFFFF;
            int t2 = curr2 >> 16;
            int min_cnt = std::min(c1, c2);
            int m = match(t1, t2);
            ans += max(0, min_cnt * m);
            if (c1 < c2) {
                curr2 = (c2 - c1) + (t2 << 16);
                curr1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                curr1 = (c1 - c2) + (t1 << 16);
                curr2 = 0;
            } else {
                curr1 = 0;
                curr2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    };

    auto minimum = [&]() {
        vector<vector<int>> l1 = {
            {rock1[0], 1},
            {sci1[0], 2},
            {paper1[0], 3}
        };
        vector<vector<int>> l2 = {
            {rock2[0], 1},
            {sci2[0], 2},
            {paper2[0], 3}
        };
        vector<vector<int>> perms1, perms2;
        int ans = INT_MAX;
        std::sort(l1.begin(), l1.end());
        do {
            perms1.push_back(l1);
        } while (std::next_permutation(l1.begin(), l1.end()));
        std::sort(l2.begin(), l2.end());
        do {
            perms2.push_back(l2);
        } while (std::next_permutation(l2.begin(), l2.end()));

        for (auto &i : perms1) {
            for (auto &j : perms2) {
                vector<vector<int>> mylist1 = i;
                vector<vector<int>> mylist2 = j;
                ans = min(ans, give(mylist1, mylist2));
            }
        }
        return ans;
    };

    cout << minimum() << " " << maximum() << "\n";

    return 0;
